# Users pack

For key-holders who submit artefacts and rely on verdicts: the working set, in the order you will need it.

## Your set

- [First verification](/docs/start/first-verification/) — the five-minute loop.

- [Write a verifiable artefact](/docs/guides/write-a-verifiable-lean-artefact/) — shape, limits, and the rejection rules.

- [Use the queue](/docs/guides/use-the-queue/) — 202s, polling, and failed jobs.

- [First certificate check](/docs/start/first-certificate-check/) and [check & revoke](/docs/guides/check-and-revoke/) — the certificate lifecycle from your side.

- [Reconcile metering](/docs/guides/reconcile-metering/) — usage records, attempts, and what never charges.

- [Ask without letting it judge](/docs/guides/use-ask-without-letting-it-judge/) — if you use the shell.

## Your standing facts

- Trial: first 10 cases per key — verdicts and usage, no certificates. Packs are priced but [not yet on sale](/pricing/).

- Your key is stored as a hash only; keep your copy safe — replacement, not recovery, is the lost-key path.

- Current state of every surface: [status](/status/). What changed: [changelog](/changelog/).

## When something is wrong

Product errors go to [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/nrupala/axiomcode/issues) (user-initiated; nothing is attached unless you choose to include it) — the acknowledgement names the issue number. Account and key questions: [contact](/contact/). Security matters never use the public form — see the [Security page](/paperwork/security/).
